description: Al-Abbas Sugar Mills Limited is a Pakistani agro-industrial company incorporated in May 1991 and listed on the Karachi Stock Exchange from April 1992. Beyond sugar, it runs a molasses-based distillery, an alloys plant, captive power generation and a bulk liquid terminal — an unusual degree of diversification for a listed sugar mill. Sugar production began in 1994, industrial alcohol in 2000, alloys in 2005 and power generation in 2010.
headOffice: Pardesi House, Survey No. 2/1, R.Y. 16, Old Queens Road, Karachi 74000, Pakistan
sourceNote: Company website (aasml.com/company-profile: incorporation in May 1991, listing in April 1992, the Mirwah Gorchani sugar and distillery unit, the Dhabeji Thatta alloys and captive-power unit, the Kemari tank terminal and the start dates of each activity; /contact-us for the head office address and telephone and for Mr Asim Ghani as chief executive), read 2026-10-17.

products.name: Sugar
products.summary: A cane crushing unit at Mirwah Gorchani with an installed capacity of 8,500 tons per day, producing since 1994.

products.name: Industrial alcohol
products.summary: A distillery processing molasses into industrial alcohol at 170,000 litres per day, in production since 2000.

products.name: Alloys
products.summary: An alloys plant at Dhabeji, Thatta with capacity for 27,220 metric tons a year, in production since 2005.

products.name: Captive power
products.summary: A 6 MW plant at the Mirwah Gorchani site serving the sugar and distillery units, and a 15 MW coal-fired captive plant at Dhabeji, generating since 2010.

products.name: Bulk liquid terminal
products.summary: A tank terminal at Kemari, Karachi with 34,900 metric tons of liquid storage capacity.
